actions.name: drive forward at 30 % without a distance

control_flow: avoidWalls: if the right light is below 60 %, then if the front obstacle sensor sees something turn left 15°, else if the left obstacle sensor sees something turn right 15°, else call driveInTheDark; if the right light is not below 60 %, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % without a distance; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front obstacle sensor sees something, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Inside a dark tunnel, steer away from its walls: turn right when a wall is close on the left, turn left when one is close on the right, and get through a bending tunnel without touching it.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60 %

the right light is not below 60 %: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first: the front obstacle sensor sees something; second: the left obstacle sensor sees something

branches.outcome: something is straight ahead: it turns left 15°
nothing is straight ahead but something is in front of its left half: it turns right 15°
nothing is seen straight ahead or on its left: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
the left light is not below 70 %: it calls stopAtWall
